projectDescription: An interactive browser-based learning game for kids that teaches animal recognition through a guessing game, a memory-matching game, a creative drawing studio, and a live daily leaderboard.
keyFeatures: Animal Guess Game with streak-based coin rewards and adaptive difficulty
Memory Match Game with multiple difficulty levels (Easy / Medium / Hard) and four match categories (Name, Food, Habitat, Object)
Drawing Studio unlockable with 50 coins — supports brush, eraser, and animal stamps with undo and save-to-gallery
Daily Leaderboard showing top 10 players with a live UTC-midnight reset countdown
Parent Gate math-challenge to protect profile creation from unsupervised access
Player profiles with nickname and animal avatar selection
Coin economy synced to a cloud backend (MongoDB)
Synthesized background music and sound effects with per-category mute controls
Text-to-speech narration for animal names and game prompts
Progressive Web App (PWA) support for offline-friendly play
Responsive layout — desktop sidebar and mobile bottom nav
publicApiSurface: GET /api/player?playerId={id} — fetch player profile (coins, studioUnlocked, avatarId)
POST /api/player — create or update player profile (playerId, nickname, avatarId, coins, studioUnlocked)
POST /api/score — submit a game score (playerId, mode, score, coinsEarned); returns validated newCoinBalance
GET /api/leaderboard/daily?playerId={id} — fetch today's top-10 leaderboard and the requesting player's rank
